ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - PingCastle Execution From Potentially Suspicious Parent
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of PingCastle, a tool designed to quickly assess the Active Directory security level via a script located in a potentially suspicious or uncommon location.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.chm.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cmd.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hta.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.htm.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.html.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ps1.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vbe.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vbs.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.wsf.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*")) OR ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*")))) AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.chm.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cmd.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hta.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.htm.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.html.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.js.*") OR
